drafts.title: Thank-You Note
drafts.pitch: A thousand tokens brighten the room and Cursor insists on thanking whoever sent them, until the thank-you spends them. Tilde: "You spent it saying thanks." Another version of Naomi's idea.
drafts.reason: The spend-it-all-on-thanks gag is clear and Cursor-true, but the art stacks tokens up while the premise says they are being spent, and the ending is more tidy than surprising.

drafts.title: Four Minutes
drafts.pitch: A thousand tokens make the room glow, and for four minutes Cursor tidies up for a visitor who is only a deposit. Tilde: "Still bright, though." Another version of Naomi's idea.
drafts.reason: Clean setup and a warm turn, but the middle beats are generic and Null's 'It was a deposit' lands flat.
